title: 第19章 名震北灵学院第20章 观摩天雷掌推演出第五式
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
“士可杀不可辱，小子，我跟你拼了。”
衣服被震碎，圆脸老者彻底暴怒了。
当下挥动拳头，朝着楚云的面门一拳轰来。
楚云道：“还不认输吗？”
随着这话响起，楚云手中的剑快速刺出。
噗嗤！
只见圆脸老者的拳头还没有靠近楚云，手臂就已经被楚云一剑刺穿。
动作虽然简单，但要是没有强大的实力，根本做不到。
啊！
手臂被刺穿，圆脸老者发出一声惨叫。
“这是什么情况，怎么如此不堪一击？”
“是啊，刚才不是很厉害吗？怎么现在不行了。”
见到楚云不但将对方的衣服震碎，还轻易刺穿对方的手臂，就跟玩一样，在场的长老和学员都露出难以置信之色。
北灵院长却是眉头一皱。
只有他看出楚云的修为，高对方太多了。
动作看似简单，但是速度已经超出了地武境范畴。
“小子，你欺人太甚！”
另外一名老者见状，挥动手臂，朝着楚云冲来。
“干什么，想二打一？”
楚云一脸不屑道：“也罢，我不介意再多收拾一个。”

随着这话响起，楚云挥动手中长剑，朝着冲来的这名老者刺去。
这名老者已经见识到楚云的厉害。
所以不等楚云攻来，他便身影一闪，消失不见。
等再次出现时，已经来到楚云的身后。
“给老夫死。”
这名老者抬起手臂，便朝着楚云的背部一掌击去。
北灵院长见状，正要出手相救，可是突然愣住。
只见楚云的身体一阵扭曲，居然化作一把剑飞射了出去。
等再次飞回来时，朝着这名老者暴刺而来。
“什么？”
这名老者见状，大惊失色。
“人剑合一，这难道就是人剑合一吗？”
“怎么可能，居然有人修炼到了这个境界。”
见到楚云施展出人剑合一，在场的人伸长了脖子，都露出震惊之色。
其中也包括北灵院长。
“这小子到底还有多少底牌没有施展出来？”
在众人震惊的目光中，楚云化作的长剑，从这名老者丹田处穿过。
噗！
当下便见这名老者张口喷出一口鲜血。
不远处，长剑消失，楚云的身形显现了出来。

“你为何不杀我，要废我的修为？”
这名老者突然单膝跪地，转头看着楚云满脸愤怒道。
楚云缓缓转过身体，看着他道：“折磨一个人最好的办法，不是杀了他，而是让他生不如死。”
听到这话，这名老者眼中露出怨毒之色。
他想出手，但是丹田传来的疼痛告诉他，他已经没有修为了。
content_en:
"Shi Ke can't be killed. Boy, I will fight with you."
The clothes were shattered, and the round-faced old man became completely furious.
He immediately waved his fist and punched Chu Yun in the face.
Chu Yun said: "Aren't you going to admit defeat?"
As these words rang out, Chu Yun quickly thrust out the sword in his hand.
Poof!
Before the round-faced old man’s fist even came close to Chu Yun, his arm had already been pierced by Chu Yun’s sword.
Although the movement is simple, it would be impossible to do without great strength.
ah!
The arm was pierced, and the round-faced old man let out a scream.
"What's going on? Why are you so vulnerable?"
"Yeah, wasn't it great just now? Why can't it be done now?"
Seeing that Chu Yun not only shattered the opponent's clothes, but also easily pierced the opponent's arm, as if for fun, the elders and students present looked in disbelief.
Dean Beiling frowned.
He was the only one who could see that Chu Yun's cultivation level was too much higher than that of the other party.
The action seemed simple, but the speed was beyond the scope of the Earth Martial Realm.
"Boy, you're going too far!"
Seeing this, another old man waved his arms and rushed towards Chu Yun.
"What are you doing, trying to fight two against one?"
Chu Yun said with disdain: "That's fine, I don't mind taking care of one more."
As these words rang out, Chu Yun waved his long sword and stabbed at the charging old man.
This old man has already seen how powerful Chu Yun is.
So before Chu Yun could attack, he flashed and disappeared.
When he appeared again, he was already behind Chu Yun.
"Death to me."
The old man raised his arm and struck Chu Yun on the back.
Upon seeing this, Dean Beiling was about to come to the rescue, but suddenly froze.
Chu Yun's body twisted and turned into a sword and flew out.
When he flew back again, he stabbed towards the old man.
"What?"
The old man was shocked when he saw this.
"The fusion of man and sword, is this the fusion of man and sword?"
"How is it possible that someone has cultivated to this level?"
Seeing Chu Yun perform the Human-Sword Fusion, everyone present stretched their necks and looked shocked.
This also includes Dean Beiling.
"How many trump cards does this kid have that he hasn't used yet?"
In the shocked eyes of everyone, the long sword transformed by Chu Yun passed through the old man's dantian.
puff!
Immediately, the old man opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of blood.
Not far away, the long sword disappeared and Chu Yun's figure appeared.
"Why don't you kill me and destroy my cultivation?"
The old man suddenly knelt down on one knee, turned to look at Chu Yun and said with anger on his face.
Chu Yun slowly turned around, looked at him and said, "The best way to torture a person is not to kill him, but to make his life worse than death."
Hearing this, the old man's eyes showed a look of resentment.
He wanted to take action, but the pain from his Dantian told him that he had no cultivation.
